about.title: Outdoor living, crafted in France.
about.intro: Since 2014, we design in Paris and manufacture in Vendée outdoor structures built to last. Every piece is unique, every project supervised by a dedicated studio lead.
about.atelierBody: Our workshop in Les Herbiers works extruded aluminium, PEFC cedar and galvanised steel. CNC machines, tenth-of-a-mm quality control, Qualicoat-certified thermo-lacquering. Nothing leaves the workshop without going through the hands of our craftspeople.

shipping.title: Delivery, install & follow-up.
shipping.intro: We handle every step, from workshop shipping to full commissioning at your home.

step1.title: 1. Manufacturing
step1.body: 3 to 5 weeks in our Vendée workshop. Tenth-of-a-mm quality control, Qualicoat-certified thermo-lacquering.

step2.title: 2. Shipping
step2.body: Appointment booked 48h before delivery. Suitable truck, tail lift for large structures.

step3.title: 3. Install
step3.body: Our team fixes, adjusts and commissions the pergola. Full site cleaning before leaving.

step4.title: 4. Follow-up
step4.body: A dedicated studio lead stays reachable during the full warranty. Interventions within 72h in mainland France.

shipping.outsideNotice: Delivery to French overseas territories and outside Europe possible on quote. Contact our team for precise pricing based on your destination.

warranty.title: One warranty, one team, one point of contact.
warranty.intro: We design our pergolas to last. Our warranties cover structure, motors, finishes and installation.

structure.title: Load-bearing structure
structure.body: Beams, rafters, posts, stainless steel brackets. Corrosion, deformation, breakage.

motors.title: Motors & LED
motors.body: Somfy motors, electronic boards, integrated LED strips, rain/wind sensors.

accessories.title: Accessories & install
accessories.body: Zip screens, glass panels, our team's labour.

coveredList: On-site intervention within 72h in mainland France
Original spare parts, at no charge
Labour included for the full warranty period
excludedList: Impact, vandalism, natural disasters (covered by your home insurance)
Modifications or repairs performed by a third party
Normal wear of sealing joints (replacement every 5 years recommended)

gazebos.title: Gazebos — The art of gathering.
gazebos.intro: A family of hexagonal and rectangular gazebos in solid cedar, with laser-cut aluminium privacy panels. Crafted in our Vendée workshop.
bullets: Bamboo or pebble privacy panels, patterns signed Atelier Rivière
Options: LED lighting, mosquito nets, zip curtains
Delivery across France, install available as an option

carports.title: Carports — Discreet, structural.
carports.intro: A range of single-car, double, or bioclimatic-pergola-integrated carports. Extruded thermo-lacquered aluminium, solid cedar, or a combination.

kitchens.title: Outdoor kitchens — The great outdoors, seated.
kitchens.intro: Modular islands, Dekton worktops, plancha, grill, sink, wine fridge. Configurable to the centimetre, designed to integrate under your pergola.
bullets: Worktops in Dekton, granite or brushed steel
Modules: gas plancha, charcoal grill, wok, teppanyaki, pizza oven
Sink, ventilated wine fridge, integrated mini-fridge
Dedicated configurator, live pricing and 3D preview

accessories.title: Accessories — Attention to detail.
accessories.intro: Perimeter LED lighting, rain-wind sensors, infrared heaters, zip curtains, matching furniture. Every accessory designed to dialogue with our structures.
bullets: Warm white or programmable RGBW LED strips
